The deepseek-harness box: a minimal Fedora base composing the nodejs and
local dsh candies. The npm builder installs @deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.7-rc.1
globally (node-pty's native module builds via node-gyp in the
fedora-builder's build-toolchain); the dsh service boots the
loopback-bound, token-authenticated web UI and a socat forwarder exposes
it on the container's eth0. The candy's checks run in BOTH contexts, so
`charly check box dsh-app` proves the CLI installs and the node floor
holds without deploying, and `charly check live` re-proves the same
shape against the running pod plus the service + web UI.

## Composition

This box composes:

- `@github.com/opencharly/layer-nodejs:v2026.272.0322`
- `dsh`
